WITH status_rates AS (
  SELECT s.healtheval, SUM(c.scancount) AS total_scancount,
         AVG(c.gbsize / c.spanmin) AS gb_per_min_rate
  FROM scans AS c
  JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
rates_with_avg AS (
  SELECT *, AVG(gb_per_min_rate) OVER () AS avg_rate_across_statuses
  FROM status_rates
)
SELECT healtheval, total_scancount, gb_per_min_rate,
       gb_per_min_rate - avg_rate_across_statuses AS rate_minus_average
FROM rates_with_avg
WHERE gb_per_min_rate > avg_rate_across_statuses
